englishTitle: Search Instability / Local Geometry Mechanism Study 1 — Prospective exact association analysis of bounded RAW local game-tree geometry with best-move, TopSet, ranking, score-gap, and principal-variation changes under deterministic search-condition perturbations in Bao
japaneseTitle: Baoにおける探索不安定性と局所ゲーム木幾何のprospective exact関連解析 — bounded RAW branching・reconvergence・reply compressionとbest-move・TopSet・ranking・score-gap・PV変動の決定論的search-condition間集中関係の検証
primaryQuestion: Within a prospectively frozen population and RAW relative-depth-5 geometry contract, are deterministic search-output changes across prespecified search-condition contrasts associated with or concentrated in particular bounded local-geometry regimes?

searchContract.topSet: all legal root moves exactly tied at maximum score
searchContract.canonicalBest: canonical-lowest move identity within TopSet; deterministic representative only
searchContract.principalVariation: canonical exact nominal PV; quiescence affects leaf score only

conditions.budgetSemantics: last completely evaluated all-root-candidates iterative-deepening depth only; partial depth discarded
last completely evaluated all-root-candidates iterative-deepening depth only; partial depth discarded

sourcePopulationPolicy.trajectoryMovePolicy: uniform over canonical-sorted engine legal move universe
sourcePopulationPolicy.phaseAssignment: SHA-256 parity of full trajectory identity with stage-specific salt
sourcePopulationPolicy.withinAssignedPhaseSelection: minimum SHA-256 rank over trajectory identity + RAW identity + ply using stage-specific salt
sourcePopulationPolicy.duplicateRawRoot: retain minimum rank only; no replacement

developmentPromotion.phaseSpecificThreshold: exact rational midpoint of the two central ordered Stage-1 geometry values in each phase; values equal to threshold are excluded from HIGH/LOW for that metric
developmentPromotion.eligibleDirection: phase-specific HIGH-minus-LOW instability risk differences must both be nonzero and have the same sign
developmentPromotion.metricSelection: among eligible G1..G5, maximize exact sum of absolute Namua and Mtaji risk differences; exact tie -> lexicographically smallest metricId
developmentPromotion.promotedIdentity: contrastId + endpointId + selected metricId + two frozen phase thresholds + frozen direction

stage2FormalRule.test: exact phase-stratified conditional association test: within each phase X=changed-in-HIGH is hypergeometric conditional on HIGH size and total changed; T=sum X across Namua and Mtaji; exact rational convolution across strata
stage2FormalRule.tail: one-sided in the Stage-1 frozen direction
stage2FormalRule.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over all estimable promoted candidates
stage2FormalRule.confirmed: all technical and estimability gates pass, effect direction matches the frozen Stage-1 direction, and Holm criterion passes
stage2FormalRule.notConfirmed: estimable candidate fails direction and/or multiplicity-aware test
stage2FormalRule.nonEstimable: frozen population/support/definition gate fails without global technical invalidity

exactArithmetic.geometry: integer or reduced rational with positive denominator
exactArithmetic.searchScores: finite exact JavaScript integer values required for decision fields; Stage 0 must demonstrate safe-integer score domain for frozen conditions or fail closed
exactArithmetic.formalProbability: BigInt combinatorics and exact reduced rational

productionIndependentContract.geometry: separate LGTGMIV-derived production and independent reconstruction paths
productionIndependentContract.search: separate G3-07 production and independent search implementations; independent may import public engine/evaluator but must not import production G3-07 search/aggregation module
productionIndependentContract.selection: production and independent population selection must be independently recomputed and canonical-exact before geometry/search measurement
productionIndependentContract.scientificEquality: canonical sorted JSON UTF-8 SHA-256 exact equality; runtime prototype identity is not a scientific equality primitive

resourceContract.searchPerConditionNodeSemantics: exact-depth has no node budget but is bounded by frozen depth; budget conditions are bounded by their explicit node budgets
resourceContract.freshStageCeilings: must be materialized in the stage-specific authorization artifact from technical-only Stage-0 measurements without reading fresh scientific roots; no post-fresh relaxation

failureHandling.mandatorySearchConditionNotEstimableAtSe: root endpoint non-estimable under frozen gate; no replacement
failureHandling.timeout: infrastructure/resource failure only; never a scientific search condition
failureHandling.artifactFailureAfterFreshAccess: no scientific recomputation; exact-byte recovery only where possible, otherwise fail closed

noRescue.crossesAt: first fresh G3-07 scientific seed/evidence generation or read
